framework.description: Initial Research Constitution for the GridEngine itself: governs the persistent always-on event-driven living Grid, continuous autonomous research threads (role-swarm org under Diagnoser/Proposer/Verifier/Consolidator/Adversary), auto-damage detection + dispatch, heartbeats, full correlation, experience layer auto-incorporation of outcomes, and observability surfaces. Schema-pack governed versionable artifact (research-constitution page_type) directly consumable by GridEngine, HealingFactor, daily_consolidation, and Constrained Evolutionary Search on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive. Self-referential: the engine and its threads are subject to the same regeneration loop.

event_bus_subscription.correlation: using_correlation_id mandatory on every handler path

background_loops: research_thread_coordinator_loop (constitution discovery + durable research_thread phase jobs)
heartbeat_loop (45s cadence for Grid + every active research thread)

autonomous_research_threads.governance: All threads load and obey research-constitution page_type artifacts (schema pack resolution). Initial set includes this GridEngine constitution + healingfactor + daily-consolidation-v3 constitutions from stabilization-wave-20260531 drive.
autonomous_research_threads.budget_discipline: Every thread iteration uses ResearchBudget (token_budget, time_budget_seconds, resilience_improvement_budget, max_experiments). record_consumption called inside runner; exhaustion forces immediate harness evaluation + keep/discard/fork decision.
autonomous_research_threads.role_swarm_org: On spawn (form_autonomous_research_thread or from damage), HealingFactor.form_research_org_thread forms Diagnoser/Proposer/Verifier/Consolidator/Adversary team with handoff protocol via shared CID + KG research_handoff edges + research-constitution charters.
autonomous_research_threads.branch_advancement: High-signal outcomes (per harness + constitution thresholds) produce forked living-experience genomes or specialized consolidation lineages via propose_experience_evolution + provenance. Only high-signal surfaced as experience-observation (research-thread subtype) or daily-present.
autonomous_research_threads.healing_integration: Bidirectional: threads can emit HealingSignalEvent; HealingFactor can spawn/consult research threads for detector/proposer evolution. Auto-dispatch on high/critical signals.

event_sources: HealingSignalEvent from synthesis, durable_job_exhaust, reconciliation, immune CRITICAL, security_posture, promotion_rejection
auto_damage_detection_and_dispatch.dispatch: On detection: emit(HealingSignalEvent) + direct HealingFactor.on_damage_signal + (high/critical) form_autonomous_research_thread. No manual intervention required.
auto_damage_detection_and_dispatch.priority_mapping: security_posture_needs_attention or synthesis_contradiction_cluster -> high; LineageImmune CRITICAL -> critical

correlation_heartbeats_experience_incorp.correlation: new_correlation_id + using_correlation_id on every loop, runner, handler, submit_queued_dream, Drive.think, run_synthesis, form_research_org_thread
correlation_heartbeats_experience_incorp.heartbeats: _record_heartbeat + dedicated _heartbeat_loop; logged with CID; feeds supervisor lease renewal for persistent research_thread jobs + KG edges for thread persistence
correlation_heartbeats_experience_incorp.auto_incorporation: On HealingSignalResolved or high-signal research outcome: increment experience_incorporations, record manifest in _research_thread_manifests, submit via supervisor 'healing' or 'research_thread' phase with healing_attempt / experience-observation + emit KG edges (healed_by, strengthened_resilience, research_thread_contributed) + schema promotion into experience layer v3 for future Drive.think

reasoning_patterns.self_governance: GridEngine is a first-class citizen of the experience layer regeneration substrate it powers.
